title: Roosevelt Rehabilitation Center & One Year in Separate Dorms
description: When their West Ocean View lease ends in March 2007 and Dad takes his new job in Northern Virginia, twenty-one-year-old Katie and Nate spend twelve months at Roosevelt Rehabilitation Center in Fishersville mastering PHP in the Web Applications Developer program—discovering firsthand why traditional gender-segregated dormitories are a nightmare for inseparable autistic twins long before anyone has heard of gender-inclusive housing.
